input.summary: Cap Customer's early termination charges at three months' Charges as the sole termination amount
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we pay no liquidated damages or penalties; where an early-termination charge is unavoidable we cap it at three months' Charges for the terminated Services as the sole amount due on termination for convenience. As drafted the charge is open-ended by reference to Attachment A and could exceed the remaining contract value.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such early termination charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' Charges for the terminated Services and will be the sole amount payable by Customer as a result of such termination.
